title: Nawat Itsaragrisil lauds Bea Millan-Windorski: 'She's the best from Asia'

blocks.text: Nawat Itsaragrisil has nothing but praise for Bea Millan-Windorski after her 2026 Miss Universe performance, with the Thai pageant personality describing the Philippine delegate as this edition’s best candidate from Asia. Itsaragrisil spoke about Windorski — who placed third runner-up — during a recent livestream on his social media page. Although the video is no longer available on his platforms, clips of it have since been reposted by netizens on TikTok. “First of all, I would like to [congratulate] Bea, the representative from the Philippines.
